Finished in striking Mythos Black Metallic with matte carbon exterior trim, this RS 7 commands attention from every angle. The matte carbon front spoiler, side sill inserts, and rear diffuser insert work in concert with black badges and window surrounds to create a cohesive, purposeful aesthetic. The 22-inch matte black five-spoke wheels shod in summer performance rubber complete the aggressive stance.

The 4.0L V8 TFSI engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and quattro all-wheel drive delivers exceptional performance. This powertrain achieves 14 city MPG and 21 highway MPG, balancing capability with efficiency for your daily drives and weekend pursuits.

Inside, the Blue RS Design Package Plus elevates the driver environment with an Alcantara-covered steering wheel and shift lever, complemented by carbon twill structure inlays with blue accents. Blue contrast stitching adorns the steering wheel, door armrests, and center console, while matching seat belts add distinctive flair. The Executive Package includes leather throughout the cabin, heated rear seats, and a heated steering wheel for year-round comfort.

Advanced technology integrates seamlessly into the driving experience. The Audi MMI Navigation Plus system with touch response delivers intuitive control, while the head-up display keeps essential information within your line of sight. The Bang & Olufsen advanced sound system with 3D sound provides premium audio quality for your entertainment needs.

Safety and convenience features include adaptive cruise assist with lane guidance, intersection assist, and Audi side assist with pre-sense rear. Remote park assist plus simplifies parking maneuvers, while power soft-closing doors add a touch of luxury to every entry and exit. SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L programming keeps you connected on every journey.

We invite you to experience this exceptional performance sedan firsthand. Contact our showroom today to schedule a test drive and discover why the 2025 Audi RS 7 performance stands as a benchmark for high-performance luxury sedans.

This 2024 Honda Civic Sport Touring offers a refined driving experience with modern features and reliable performance in an attractive white exterior.

- 12 Speakers with BOSE Premium Audio System
- AM/FM Radio with SiriusXM
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow
- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS)
- Blind Spot Information (BSI) System warning
- Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with leather trim
- Power moonroof
- Auto High-beam Headlights with delay-off function
- Front fog lights
- 18" Alloy Wheels
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Power driver and passenger seats with automatic temperature control

The 1.5L four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission delivers strong efficiency, achieving 30 MPG city and 37 MPG highway. This powertrain is engineered to provide dependable performance while maintaining fuel economy for daily driving and longer commutes alike.

Safety is a priority in this Civic, equipped with adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assistance, and blind spot monitoring to provide confidence on varied road conditions. The vehicle includes dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and electronic stability control work together to support responsive braking and vehicle control.

Inside, the Sport Touring trim features leather-trimmed front bucket seats with heating capability, along with a front center armrest and split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space. The power moonroof adds natural light and an open-air feel. Automatic temperature control with dual front and rear zone settings ensures passenger comfort regardless of season.

Technology and connectivity are seamless with the Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto compatibility. The BOSE premium audio system with 12 speakers delivers quality sound, while SiriusXM radio access provides entertainment options. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow you to manage functions without taking your hands off the wheel.

This vehicle presents a well-equipped compact sedan with low mileage at 7,890 miles, combining Honda reliability with modern comfort and safety amenities. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the 2024 Civic Sport Touring firsthand.

Safety features work quietly in the background. Forward collision warning with autonomous emergency braking, lane departure warning, and a comprehensive airbag system provide protection. The electronic stability control and traction control systems enhance handling confidence in varying conditions.

Lamborghini Paramus is proud to present this 2009 MINI Cooper John Cooper Works Hardtop finished in Pepper White over Carbon Black Checkered Cloth. Combining legendary go-kart handling with factory-developed performance, the John Cooper Works model represents the pinnacle of the R56 generation. Powered by a turbocharged 1.6-liter twin-scroll four-cylinder engine paired with a highly desirable 6-speed Getrag manual transmission, this JCW delivers an engaging driving experience that continues to make it one of the most sought-after modern MINI models among enthusiasts.

Developed directly from MINI's motorsport heritage, the John Cooper Works package elevates the Cooper S with increased power, upgraded suspension tuning, larger Brembo front brakes, a sport-tuned twin-pipe exhaust system, aggressive aerodynamic enhancements, and distinctive styling cues. The result is a lightweight hot hatch that offers exceptional responsiveness, precise steering, and an unmistakable exhaust note that rewards every drive.

Finished in classic Pepper White, this example is equipped with the factory Aerodynamic Kit, Xenon Headlights, White Turn Indicators, Bluetooth with USB and iPod connectivity, the Premium Package, and the Cold Weather Package. Exterior highlights include the signature hood scoop, rear spoiler, black honeycomb grille, chrome fuel filler cap, front fog lights, and body-colored sport bumpers, giving the JCW its unmistakable performance-inspired appearance.

Inside, the cabin features Carbon Black Checkered Cloth seating, Piano Black interior trim, an Anthracite headliner, stainless steel sport pedals, a leather sport steering wheel, and the iconic center-mounted speedometer. Additional amenities include Sport Mode, an onboard computer, ambient interior lighting, split-folding rear seats, power windows, multiple storage compartments, automatic climate-controlled features, and a six-speaker audio system.

Performance is delivered through the turbocharged 1.6-liter engine, front-wheel drive, fully electronic throttle control, MacPherson front suspension, multi-link rear suspension, speed-sensitive rack-and-pinion steering, ventilated disc brakes, and four-piston Brembo front calipers. Together, these components create the sharp, confidence-inspiring handling characteristics that have made the John Cooper Works badge legendary.

Safety features include dual-stage front airbags, front seat-mounted side airbags, front and rear side curtain airbags, four-wheel anti-lock brakes (ABS), Cornering Brake Control (CBC), Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD), tire pressure monitoring, ISOFIX/LATCH child seat anchors, and MINI's crash sensor system.

Whether you're searching for a weekend toy, an engaging daily driver, or a future collectible performance hatchback, this 2009 MINI Cooper John Cooper Works offers an exciting blend of motorsport engineering, iconic British design, and everyday usability. As factory manual performance cars continue to become increasingly rare, this JCW represents an outstanding opportunity to own one of the most entertaining hot hatches of its generation.

Why buy HondaTrue Certified from Honda World? When you choose HondaTrue Certified such as this Urban Gray Pearl 2026 Honda Civic Hatchback Sport with 1,053 miles, you are not just buying a pre-owned vehicle... you're getting a Honda-backed limited warranty for confidence and peace of mind! What this vehicle includes: Convenience
  • Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
  • Keyfob engine start control - Get an early start. Remotely start your vehicle's engine from the key fob, ensuring your ride is ready to go when you get in. Now you can stay comfortable inside while your vehicle gets comfortable outside, thanks to Keyfob engine start control.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

This 2023 Toyota Prius XLE delivers efficiency and reliability wrapped in a beige exterior that stands out with its distinctive appearance.

- AM/FM radio with SiriusXM
- Apple CarPlay integration

- Keyless entry with remote access

- Four-wheel independent suspension

The Prius XLE achieves an impressive 52 mpg in both city and highway driving, making every trip to the pump a less frequent occurrence. With its 2.0L 4-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission, this hybrid delivers smooth, responsive performance while maintaining exceptional fuel economy. The front-wheel drive system provides confident handling in various driving conditions.

Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin designed for comfort and convenience. The automatic temperature control keeps the cabin at your preferred setting, while the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in all weather. The split folding rear seat offers flexible cargo space for your lifestyle, and the front center armrest and rear seat center armrest provide comfort for all passengers.

Technology features include SiriusXM radio with its extensive programming options, Apple CarPlay for seamless smartphone integration, and Bluetooth connectivity. The backup camera aids in parking and reversing, while steering wheel mounted audio controls keep your hands where they should be.

Safety is a priority with this Prius. The vehicle includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system including dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, and overhead airbags. The emergency communication system with Safety Connect trial subscription adds an extra layer of security.

Additional comfort and convenience features include heated door mirrors, power windows, remote keyless entry, delay-off headlights, speed-sensitive wipers, and alloy wheels. The trip computer and outside temperature display keep you informed during your drive.

This 2023 Toyota Prius XLE represents a smart choice for drivers seeking fuel efficiency, reliability, and practical features in a well-rounded package. Visit our showroom to see this vehicle in person and experience what it can offer you.

- Touchscreen Media Display

Finished in Black, this Cooper S presents a striking exterior that commands attention. The 17-inch Pedal Spoke Black Alloy wheels enhance the vehicle's athletic stance, while the body-color roof and roof rails add purposeful style. The comprehensive lighting package—including fully automatic headlights, front fog lights, rear fog lights, and delay-off functionality—ensures confident visibility in all conditions.

The 2.0L 16V TwinPower Turbo engine paired with a 7-Speed Automatic transmission delivers responsive performance with impressive fuel economy at 28 city and 38 highway miles per gallon. This front-wheel-drive setup provides balanced handling and everyday practicality without compromise.

Step inside and discover a thoughtfully appointed cabin. The heated sport seats wrapped in SensaTec leatherette upholstery offer comfort and support, while the Nappa leather steering wheel adds a touch of refinement. Climate control is managed through dual-zone automatic temperature regulation, and the heated steering wheel provides warmth on cooler mornings. The panoramic moonroof floods the interior with natural light and creates an open, airy atmosphere.

Technology integrates seamlessly throughout this Cooper S. The touchscreen media display connects easily with Apple CarPlay, while the harman/kardon Premium Sound System elevates your audio enjoyment. SiriusXM Satellite Radio keeps you entertained with your favorite programming. Comfort Access Keyless Entry allows effortless vehicle access, and the rear-view camera with rear park distance control simplifies maneuvering in tight spaces.

Safety receives thorough attention with features including six airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, and an emergency communication system. The active driving assistant works alongside these systems to help keep you confident on the road.

We invite you to experience this 2023 MINI Cooper S Signature in person. Its well-appointed interior, spirited performance, and attention to detail make it an intelligent choice for drivers seeking distinction and capability.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them.
